preconditions.description: The contract must have some CLE tokens in its balance (for swapAndLiquify to work)
Contract token balance must be >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity (500 * 10^9)

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the _approve function where the 'owner' parameter shadows the Ownable.owner state variable. Call approve() or transferFrom() with carefully crafted parameters to make _approve set allowances for address(0) as the owner. Then trigger swapAndLiquify which calls _approve(address(this), router, amount) - this will set allowance for address(0) as owner instead of address(this). The router will fail to spend tokens, but the key is that _approve doesn't check if owner == address(0). This can be used to corrupt the allowance mapping and potentially lock funds or cause unexpected behavior.
